name: Makishima Ikuto
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c51278]Nagisa's[/url] childhood friend, his idol and hero. Ikuto is reliable, handsome, smart, popular and good at pretty much everything. Nagisa admires him deeply and looks to him as a role model.  He's a year older than Nagisa and currently in his senior year of middle school. His parents and older sister died in a car accident a few years ago, which is why he lives alone despite his young age. He's a former student council president and still regularly hangs out at the student council room.
